rho_reference.band_basis: the row's reported arm at its largest size (icv1-f2m61-t158598901-ab42b6c5, 2^47.2); the index calculus is timed by the clock, so it carries no unpriced native work; the canonicalisations rho's walk leaves uncharged (median 1330817.5 a process) are priced at 0, 0.1 and 1 GAE each
rho_reference.binary_or_process: the row's own `ic` binary and process: both arms rebuilt from nothing each repetition, the index calculus first
rho_reference.protocol: ledger section 23's one-target rho on the same public point, in the same `ic price --single-target` process: the signed-Frobenius r-adding walk (negation and Frobenius classes), its set-up plus its walk; the walk priced at the canonical batched step this process measures (`s_rho_model`), the stronger of the two references the process records

rho_as_built.note: the reference the published row quotes; it pays more than the canonical step for a walk step, so the published distance to rho is the smaller of the two

rho_reference.unit: S: cold time in v0's unit (one batched addition) over sqrt(r)
